title: What the customer really wanted
caption: AI does not guarantee the right result. A wrong handover can still lead to a wrong result—sometimes faster.

why-the-line-gets-out-of-balance.header: Why the line gets out of balance
why-the-line-gets-out-of-balance.description: DORA's 2025 report overview says AI's primary role is as an amplifier, magnifying an organization's existing strengths and weaknesses, and that the greatest returns come from a focus on the organizational system rather than the tools. It is an overview page; the report text was not read [1].

dora-2025-overview.title: DORA, State of AI-assisted Software Development 2025 (overview page)

the-hook.title: The Hook
the-hook.script: That is the point from a moment ago: a wrong swing can be built faster. This is an illustration, not a measured promise. Keep it in mind as we look at what can shape the result and what you can do about it.

cartoon-to-balanced-line.title: Cartoon to balanced line
cartoon-to-balanced-line.script: Now picture the cartoon turning into a real factory line. Input comes in at a steady rate, stations keep pace, and the output is steady. If work flowed this smoothly in your organization, there might be less to solve here.

reality.title: Reality
reality.script: Real work does not always flow like the cartoon. A change at one station can create a queue elsewhere, but the effect depends on the work. Trying to speed up every step does not guarantee better flow. Look at the line you work in and ask yourself: which station is yours?
